summary: Recent changes to the image decoding process in Firefox involve unifying the handling of MozPromise, which is a system used to manage asynchronous operations in JavaScript. This update streamlines how promises work within image decoding, making the browser more efficient and reliable when loading images. **This matters because it can lead to faster page loads and a smoother user experience when viewing images online**, ultimately enhancing the overall performance of the browser while ensuring that images are displayed correctly and quickly.
